scope: Criterion-bound source-oracle framework, packet-completeness question and source hash preflight

metrics.policy: Positive abstentions/errors count as FN; unresolved negatives are not TN. Accuracy denominator is every labeled case. Dry-run has no measured confusion.

live_trial.corpus: Selected public Requests/Rich/Click cases; not an independent holdout
live_trial.evidence: Exact excerpts, revision/path/digest, neutral AST facts, three controlled execution observations
live_trial.result: No admitted decisions. Jev stays experimental/advisory; no 99.85% accuracy claim.

before_after.meaning: Packet probabilities increased but unchanged decision coverage does not substantiate accuracy improvement.

prohibited_inferences: Source digest verifies excerpt bytes, not upstream authenticity
AI agreement is not human-heldout accuracy
Controlled execution is not full repository mutation coverage
Local journal integrity is not externally anchored approval
